faqs.question: How do I download an editable class routine in Microsoft Word format?
faqs.answer: Go to Student Tools → My Routine. Download the blank Word template or export your own routine as an editable .docx table. Published sample schedules are examples; verify actual class arrangements with your department.

faqs.question: Where are my personal timetable changes saved?
faqs.answer: Your personal routine is saved in this browser on this device. It is not a cloud backup. Export a JSON backup to transfer it or protect against browser storage being cleared.

faqs.question: Does installing the app download all Google Drive materials?
faqs.answer: No. Installation caches the public application shell. Google Drive documents remain online; opening or downloading a file requires access to that file. AI also needs an online provider connection.
